description: content.md is sealed and schema.yaml declares required sections, but encryption/policy.yaml carries no structure attestation, so a validator cannot evaluate section binding at all. Spec 5.2.1 requires the attestation in exactly this case. The expected verdict is E_POLICY_INVALID once, naming the encryptor's omission - NOT E_REQUIRED_SECTION_MISSING per section, which would blame the document for something that may well be fine.
